Routes by register: brand → soul + spectacle engine; product → palette + component system + density (split further into pages you READ = dashboards, pages you OPERATE = consoles/wizards, and and a DELEGATION layer that stacks on either when an agent does the work); commerce → PDP/PLP skeletons + anti-dark-pattern rules; h5 → a fixed 390×844 frame, safe-area math, thumb-zone hierarchy, and native furniture (status bar, TabBar, bottom sheet, FAB, push & FLIP transitions) across six phone morphologies. Always reads the brief first and audits against an anti-slop cheapness blacklist. Ships an anti-sameness layer (divergence) that composes a soul from five orthogonal axes instead of picking from a persona list, so repeat runs stop converging on one look. Routes single-element briefs to a component flow (8 mandatory states + a preview file) instead of the page apparatus. Carries a cross-run build log so rotation is enforced rather than narrated, and a mobile floor covering the six ways a crafted page breaks on a phone. Supports verb commands (audit · bolder · quieter · soul · diverge · animate · densify · redesign) for targeted iteration. Ships a motion layer that separates WHAT moves from HOW it is built: six routes (CSS · native scroll-driven · View Transitions/WAAPI · GSAP · Canvas/WebGL · zero-dependency CSS 3D space) against a ten-family effect catalogue of ~80 variants (spatial camera moves, particle fields, fluid & material, scroll narrative, typographic, image transform, geometric construction, physics & inertia, state transition, atmosphere), each family carrying its slop form; an effect→route lookup so a page stops shipping 60KB to do four lines of work; and a four-beat sheet that replaces "one spectacular hero over generic fade-ups" — because 「炫酷」 and 「好看」 select nothing, and every model answers them with the same particle hero. Separates 后台 (revolves around a batch of business objects) from 工作台 (revolves around one thing he does over and over) — one fork that decides density, soul and shell, resolved by what the thing revolves around rather than by head-count or screen; a workbench then picks a body, desktop or phone morph A.1. skills.description:
Self-learning memory system with evolution engine, decay-based forgetting, and multi-trigger reflection.
Builds a persistent knowledge base from user corrections, self-reflection, and automated pattern detection.
Trigger when: user corrects you, says "reflect"/"回顾"/"反思"/"做梦", asks "what do you know about X"/"你学到了什么", says "forget X"/"记住这个", significant task completed, heartbeat/scheduled task runs.
Do NOT trigger for: simple Q&A, greetings, one-time instructions.
skills.description_zh:
描述（中文）
自学习记忆进化系统，以进化引擎、衰减遗忘和多触发反思仿人类记忆模式。从用户纠正、自我反思和自动模式检测中构建持久知识库。
描述（英文）
Self-learning memory system with evolution engine, decay-based forgetting, and multi-trigger reflection. Builds persistent knowledge from corrections, self-reflection, and automated pattern detection.

完整描述
Memory Evolution — 统一的 AI 自学习记忆进化系统

让 AI 拥有持久记忆、从错误中自我进化、自动管理知识生命周期。

合并了 self-improving（我第一代进化引擎）+ cognitive-memory（衰减遗忘）+ ontology（结构化知识）三个技能的精华，打磨为一个开箱即用的系统。

🔥 三层存储架构

层级	用途	行为
HOT	核心规则、用户偏好、纠正记录	始终加载在上下文中（每文件≤100行）
WARM	项目级经验、领域知识	按需加载（每文件≤200行）
COLD	归档的历史经验	仅显式查询时检索
自动升降级：7天内使用3次的模式提升到 HOT；30天未使用的降级到 WARM；衰减到阈值以下归档到 COLD。

🧬 进化引擎

四模块协同工作，全程本地运行，无需网络：

Sensor — 自动记录每次任务的成败结果和上下文
World Model — 分析历史数据，预测哪种做法更容易成功
Evo Devo — 用遗传算法思路生成新策略提案
Covenant — 安全守卫，拦截危险策略
引擎经历四个成长阶段：embryonic（被动记录）→ juvenile（开始提议）→ mature（主动进化）→ expert（高置信预测）。

⏳ 科学衰减遗忘

不是简单的时间清理，而是仿���脑的衰减模型：

relevance = base × e^(-0.03 × 天数) × log2(访问次数 + 1) × 类型权重
核心规则（HOT）衰减更慢（权重 1.5）
用户纠正保留更久（权重 1.2）
项目经验衰减较快（权重 0.8）
永远不会自动删除——只归档，不丢失
💭 三种反思触发

自动反思 — 完成重要任务后（5+工具调用或修改2+文件），自问"学到了什么"，记录非显而易见的经验
手动反思 — 用户说"反思""回顾""做梦"时，读取近期所有记忆，提取2-4个模式，写入前确认
定时做梦 — 融入心跳/定时任务，定期重算衰减分数、降级过期条目、提取待审提案
🔒 安全设计

写入核心记忆（HOT）前必须向用户确认
遗忘操作需要用户确认后才执行
归档操作只移不移删，记录操作原因
用户纠正优先级高于一切（包括引擎提案）
绝不从沉默中推断偏好
🚀 快速开始

安装后运行 python scripts/init.py 即可初始化数据目录，支持 --path 自定义位置。跨平台支持（Windows/macOS/Linux）。

适用场景：

长期项目中让 AI 积累领域经验
团队协作中让 AI 记住每个人的偏好和纠正
复杂系统中让 AI 自动发现和优化工作模式
任何需要 AI "越用越懂你" 的场景
skills.name: 记忆进化 Memory Evolution

skills.description: AIEOS (AI Entity Object Specification) is a standardization framework designed to solve the "identity crisis" currently facing AI agents. The goal is to establish a standardized data structure that defines exactly how an agent speaks, reacts, and remembers. This allows developers, and agents themselves, to construct specific personas with the portability to move across different ecosystems without losing their behavioral integrity. As we move toward a world of "Agentic Workflows," AIEOS ensures that agents maintain consistent traits regardless of the underlying model. By treating personality as a deployable asset rather than a fragile prompt, we are providing the "DNA kit" for the next generation of digital entities.
